name: GoodNotes
description_en:
Goodnotes brings handwriting, PDF annotation, typed documents, audio and whiteboards into a digital note workspace. The current site addresses both individual tablet users and teams, with paid collaboration and administration tiers. It should be evaluated around the actual device and document workflow.

The current pricing page and its linked Markdown companion give useful plan details but disagree on some entitlements and AI add-on wording. This draft preserves those uncertainties rather than treating all listed capabilities as universally available.
description_zh:
Goodnotes 把手写、PDF 批注、文字文档、音频与白板放入数字笔记工作区。当前官网同时面向个人平板用户与团队，提供付费协作和管理档位。选型应围绕真实设备与文档流程进行。

当前定价页及其链接的 Markdown 说明提供了有用的套餐信息，但部分权益和 AI 附加包表述不一致。本文保留这些不确定性，不把所有功能视为任何套餐均可使用。

core_features.explanation_en: Import PDFs, add handwriting/typed comments and export annotated files.
core_features.explanation_zh: 导入 PDF，添加手写／文字评论，导出批注文件。

core_features.explanation_en: Notebooks, typed documents and whiteboards support different inputs.
core_features.explanation_zh: 笔记本、文字文档与白板支持不同输入形式。

core_features.explanation_en: Private links, real-time work and administration depend on plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 私密链接、实时共同编辑及管理能力受套餐约束。

en: Combine handwritten study notes and source PDFs.
zh: 结合手写学习笔记与来源 PDF。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Vendor apps and account services across documented platforms; feature parity varies.
Deployment.zh: 厂商应用和账户服务覆盖文档所列平台，功能一致性需分别核对。

steps.en: Install on the intended device, create a notebook and import a disposable PDF.
steps.zh: 在目标设备安装，创建笔记本并导入临时 PDF。

steps.en: Annotate, export and inspect the result outside the app.
steps.zh: 批注后导出，并在应用外检查结果。

steps.en: Confirm the current plan for sync, sharing and AI before a second-device or team rollout.
steps.zh: 向第二台设备或团队推广前，确认当前套餐的同步、共享与 AI 条件。

items.en: Goodnotes is a plausible choice for handwritten study, annotated reports and visual discussion. A text-only personal notebook may need less account and platform complexity; an audited document-control process needs more than a shared notebook. No self-hosted package or open-source licence was verified. AI summaries, recognised handwriting and equations still need source checking; this research did not measure accuracy, reliability or the promotional productivity statistics on the site.
items.zh: 对于手写学习、报告批注和可视化讨论，Goodnotes 值得考虑。纯文字个人笔记可能不需要同等账户和平台复杂度；需审计的文控流程也不能仅靠共享笔记本。未核实自行部署包或开源许可。AI 摘要、识别的手写和公式仍需对照来源；本次未测量准确率、可靠性或官网宣传的生产力统计。

pricing.billing_basis: Annual base plans; Teams per seat; separate monthly AI Pass.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Essential $11.99/year; Pro $35.99/year; Teams $120/seat/year. Seven-day individual trials, 30-day Teams; regional price and conflicting add-on/sync details need checkout confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Essential 每年 11.99；Pro 每年 35.99；Teams 每席位每年 120。个人试用七天，Teams 30 天；地区价格及有冲突的附加包／同步细节需在结账确认。

Historical directory assertions are superseded, including unverified feature and API labels.

sections.title_en: Review a PDF with handwritten context
sections.title_zh: 通过手写上下文审阅 PDF
sections.en: An illustrative review starts by importing a report, handwriting comments and highlights beside the relevant clauses, and exporting an annotated copy for a colleague. The PDF page documents typing, handwriting, searchable annotations and export. For a handover, verify that the exported file renders the intended markups outside Goodnotes; being searchable inside the app and being editable in another PDF tool are separate requirements.
sections.zh: 示例流程是导入报告，在相关条款旁手写评论和高亮，再导出带批注副本交给同事。PDF 页面说明可打字、手写、搜索批注和导出。交付时应在 Goodnotes 外确认导出文件显示所需标记；应用内可搜索与其他 PDF 工具可编辑是不同要求。

sections.title_en: A notebook is only one work surface
sections.title_zh: 笔记本只是其中一种工作界面
sections.en: Goodnotes now documents notebooks, typed documents and infinite-canvas whiteboards, plus audio capture and AI assistance. Its homepage supports Apple and other platform downloads, but a feature list does not establish cross-platform parity. The pricing comparison explicitly marks handwriting sensitivity as iOS-only. Confirm the specific operating system, input device, sync route and account before choosing it for field work or a mixed-device team.
sections.zh: Goodnotes 当前说明了笔记本、文字文档、无限画布白板，以及音频记录和 AI 辅助。首页提供 Apple 与其他平台下载，但功能清单不证明跨平台完全一致。定价对照明确把手写灵敏度标为仅 iOS 可用。外出工作或混合设备团队选用前，应确认具体系统、输入设备、同步方式和账户。

sections.title_en: Annual base plans and separate AI spend
sections.title_zh: 年度基础套餐与独立 AI 费用
sections.en: The individual/business cards list Free, Essential at $11.99/year, Pro at $35.99/year and Teams at $120/seat/year; Enterprise requires contact. These dollar amounts are a dated page snapshot, not a regional checkout quote. Essential/Pro advertise seven-day trials and Teams 30 days. Free has three notebooks and limited storage/imports. The linked Markdown explains annual base billing and read-only excess notebooks after downgrade. It places AI Pass around $10/month, while HTML shows $9.99. Confirm the payable add-on and included credits before buying.
sections.zh: 个人／商务卡片列出 Free、Essential 每年 11.99、Pro 每年 35.99、Teams 每席位每年 120；Enterprise 询价。这些美元符号金额是带日期的页面快照，不是地区结账报价。Essential／Pro 宣传七天试用，Teams 为 30 天。Free 限三个笔记本，存储与导入也有限制。链接的 Markdown 说明基础套餐按年收费，降级后超额笔记本只读；其 AI Pass 约为每月 10，而 HTML 为 9.99。购买前需确认实际附加费及所含额度。

sections.en: Pro adds private links and real-time collaboration on the current cards, while Teams adds central account management and consolidated billing. The linked Markdown puts cross-platform sync on Essential and above, while HTML highlights it under Pro. This is a source discrepancy, not a confirmed entitlement. A team evaluation should check an external recipient, a removed member and the intended paid/free combination before sensitive material is shared.
sections.zh: 当前卡片把私密链接和实时协作列为 Pro 增量，Teams 增加集中账户管理和合并账单。链接的 Markdown 把跨平台同步列为 Essential 及以上，而 HTML 在 Pro 下突出它。这是来源差异，并非已经确认的权益。团队评估应检查外部接收者、被移除成员及实际付费／免费组合的行为，再共享敏感资料。

research_gaps.en: HTML and linked Markdown differ on sync eligibility and AI Pass price; selected-platform checkout and entitlements need confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: HTML 与链接的 Markdown 在同步资格和 AI Pass 价格上不同，需确认目标平台结账及权益。

research_gaps.en: No handwriting, export fidelity, AI accuracy, cross-platform sync or team permissions were tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试手写、导出保真度、AI 准确率、跨平台同步或团队权限。
